# control-character scheme bypass — browsers strip <=0x20 before parsing
# a URL's scheme, so a naive prefix blocklist can be evaded this way
[click](jav	ascript:alert(1))
[click](java\nscript:alert(1))
[[jav	ascript:alert(1)]]

# unknown scheme must be blocked by the allowlist, not just a blocklist
[click](steam://run)
